doctor.name: Dr. Shrestha Singh
doctor.title: Dr.
doctor.bio: Dr. Shrestha Singh is a registered dental surgeon with a patient-first approach to dentistry. She completed her dental education and is registered with the Dental Council of India. Her clinical practice focuses on providing ethical, evidence-based dental care with clear communication and minimal discomfort.
doctor.philosophy: My goal is simple — to provide honest dental care in a safe and comfortable environment, without unnecessary procedures.
doctor.approach: Dr. Singh strongly believes that informed patients make better decisions. She takes time to explain treatment options, procedures, and after-care so patients feel confident and relaxed. She has a special interest in preventive dentistry, painless restorative treatments, and helping patients who experience dental anxiety.

intro.title: Welcome to SmileSure Dental Care
intro.content: At SmileSure, we believe dental care should be calm, transparent, and respectful. Our focus is not just treatment, but helping patients understand their oral health and feel comfortable at every step. Whether you are visiting for a routine check-up or a specific concern, you can expect honest advice, modern techniques, and strict hygiene standards.
